audit.summary: The current paper retains an incorrect exact-skewness claim under the standard Type-I Pareto interpretation, and the current author memory path can use equal-time events across batch boundaries despite the strict-past task definition. Both are Minor within the available evidence: a distribution convention can repair the first, while the second has no quantified current benchmark effect.

The Pareto conclusion is explicitly conditional on the distribution convention.
